sections.skill: Compare business structures and set prices using costs and markup

questions.prompt: Dev runs his business alone and has not registered any special structure. What is it, by default?
questions.intro: A sole proprietorship is one owner with no separate legal entity; it is simple but the owner is personally liable for business debts. An LLC or corporation is formed with the state and can limit personal liability.
questions.feedback: One owner with no separate entity is a sole proprietorship.
questions.topic: Business structures, pricing, and getting started

New Jersey Business Portal: New Jersey explains how to register a business, collect sales tax, and get required licenses. (https://business.nj.gov/)

questions.prompt: What is the main advantage of forming an LLC?

choices.text: It means the business pays no taxes at all
It guarantees the business will make a profit every year
It removes the need for any records
It can protect personal assets from business debts

questions.correct_answer: It can protect personal assets from business debts
questions.intro: A limited liability company (LLC) is formed by filing with the state. It separates the business from the owner, which can protect the owner's personal assets from business debts.
questions.feedback: LLCs can limit the owner's personal liability.

questions.prompt: A mug costs Dev $6 to make. He uses a 50% markup on cost. What is the price?
questions.intro: Cost-plus pricing: price = cost × (1 + markup percent).

sections.relationship: Markup is a percent increase on cost.

ref_skill.name: Find a percent increase or a percent decrease

questions.prompt: A cap costs $8 and sells for $12. What is the markup percent on cost?
questions.intro: Markup percent = (price − cost) ÷ cost × 100. Margin uses price instead: (price − cost) ÷ price.
